dhpak1.15:2.1: Bahumpi ceti imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ satthā jetavane
dhpak1.15:3.1: Sāvatthivāsino hi dve kulaputtā sahāyakā vihāraṃ gantvā
dhpak1.15:3.2: satthu dhammadesanaṃ sutvā kāme pahāya sāsane uraṃ datvā
dhpak1.15:3.4: vasitvā satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā sāsane dhuraṃ pucchitvā
dhpak1.15:4.1: vipassanādhurañca ganthadhurañca vitthārato sutvā eko tāva “ ahaṃ, bhante,
dhpak1.15:4.2: mahallakakāle pabbajito na sakkhissāmi ganthadhuraṃ pūretuṃ, vipassanādhuraṃ pana pūressāmī ”
dhpak1.15:5.1: ti yāva arahattā vipassanādhuraṃ kathāpetvā ghaṭento vāyamanto saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
dhpak1.15:5.2: Itaro pana “ ahaṃ ganthadhuraṃ pūressāmī ” ti anukkamena tepiṭakaṃ buddhavacanaṃ
dhpak1.15:5.3: uggaṇhitvā gatagataṭṭhāne dhammaṃ katheti, sarabhaññaṃ bhaṇati,
dhpak1.15:5.4: pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ dhammaṃ vācento vicarati. Aṭṭhārasannaṃ mahāgaṇānaṃ ācariyo ahosi.
dhpak1.15:6.1: Bhikkhū satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā itarassa therassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā tassa ovāde ṭhatvā
dhpak1.15:6.2: arahattaṃ patvā theraṃ vanditvā,“ satthāraṃ daṭṭhukāmamhā ” ti vadanti. Thero “ gacchatha, āvuso,
dhpak1.15:6.3: mama vacanena satthāraṃ vanditvā asīti mahāthere vandatha, sahāyakattherampi me ‘ amhākaṃ ācariyo
dhpak1.15:6.4: tumhe vandatī ’ ti vadathā ” ti peseti. Te bhikkhū vihāraṃ gantvā satthārañceva asīti mahāthere
dhpak1.15:6.5: ca vanditvā ganthikattherassa santikaṃ gantvā,“ bhante, amhākaṃ ācariyo tumhe vandatī ” ti vadanti.
dhpak1.15:6.6: Itarena ca “ ko nāma so ” ti vutte,“ tumhākaṃ sahāyakabhikkhu, bhante ” ti vadanti.
dhpak1.15:7.1: Evaṃ there punappunaṃ sāsanaṃ pahiṇante so bhikkhu thokaṃ kālaṃ sahitvā aparabhāge sahituṃ asakkonto “ amhākaṃ ācariyo tumhe
dhpak1.15:7.2: vandatī ” ti vutte,“ ko eso ” ti vatvā “ tumhākaṃ sahāyakabhikkhū ” ti vutte,“ kiṃ pana tumhehi tassa santike uggahitaṃ,
dhpak1.15:7.3: kiṃ dīghanikāyādīsu aññataro nikāyo, kiṃ tīsu piṭakesu ekaṃ piṭakan ” ti vatvā “ catuppadikampi gāthaṃ na jānāti,
dhpak1.15:7.4: paṃsukūlaṃ gahetvā pabbajitakāleyeva araññaṃ paviṭṭho, bahū vata antevāsike labhi, tassa āgatakāle mayā pañhaṃ pucchituṃ vaṭṭatī ” ti cintesi.
dhpak1.15:8.1: Atha aparabhāge thero satthāraṃ daṭṭhuṃ āgato.
dhpak1.15:8.2: Sahāyakassa therassa santike pattacīvaraṃ ṭhapetvā gantvā satthārañceva asīti
dhpak1.15:8.3: mahāthere ca vanditvā sahāyakassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ paccāgami.
dhpak1.15:8.4: Athassa so vattaṃ kāretvā samappamāṇaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā,“ pañhaṃ pucchissāmī ” ti nisīdi.
dhpak1.15:9.1: Tasmiṃ khaṇe satthā “ esa evarūpaṃ mama puttaṃ viheṭhetvā niraye
dhpak1.15:9.2: nibbatteyyā ” ti tasmiṃ anukampāya vihāracārikaṃ caranto viya
dhpak1.15:10.1: Tattha tattha nisīdantā hi bhikkhū buddhāsanaṃ paññāpetvāva nisīdanti.
dhpak1.15:11.1: Nisajja kho pana ganthikabhikkhuṃ paṭhamajjhāne pañhaṃ pucchitvā tasmiṃ
dhpak1.15:11.2: akathite dutiyajjhānaṃ ādiṃ katvā aṭṭhasupi samāpattīsu rūpārūpesu ca pañhaṃ pucchi.
dhpak1.15:11.3: Ganthikatthero ekampi kathetuṃ nāsakkhi. Itaro taṃ sabbaṃ kathesi.
dhpak1.15:12.1: Atha naṃ sotāpattimagge pañhaṃ pucchi. Ganthikatthero kathetuṃ nāsakkhi.
dhpak1.15:12.2: Tato khīṇāsavattheraṃ pucchi. Thero kathesi. Satthā “ sādhu sādhu,
dhpak1.15:12.3: bhikkhū ” ti abhinanditvā sesamaggesupi paṭipāṭiyā pañhaṃ pucchi.
dhpak1.15:13.1: Ganthiko ekampi kathetuṃ nāsakkhi, khīṇāsavo pucchitaṃ pucchitaṃ kathesi.
dhpak1.15:13.2: Satthā catūsupi ṭhānesu tassa sādhukāraṃ adāsi. Taṃ sutvā bhummadeve ādiṃ
dhpak1.15:13.3: katvā yāva brahmalokā sabbā devatā ceva nāgasupaṇṇā ca sādhukāraṃ adaṃsu.
dhpak1.15:14.1: Taṃ sādhukāraṃ sutvā tassa antevāsikā ceva saddhivihārino ca satthāraṃ ujjhāyiṃsu – “ kiṃ nāmetaṃ satthārā kataṃ,
dhpak1.15:14.2: kiñci ajānantassa mahallakattherassa catūsu ṭhānesu sādhukāraṃ adāsi, amhākaṃ panācariyassa
dhpak1.15:14.3: sabbapariyattidharassa pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ pāmokkhassa pasaṃsāmattampi na karī ” ti.
dhpak1.15:15.1: Atha ne satthā “ kiṃ nāmetaṃ, bhikkhave, kathethā ” ti pucchitvā tasmiṃ atthe ārocite,“ bhikkhave,
dhpak1.15:15.2: tumhākaṃ ācariyo mama sāsane bhatiyā gāvo rakkhaṇasadiso, mayhaṃ pana putto
dhpak1.15:15.3: yathāruciyā pañca gorase paribhuñjanakasāmisadiso ” ti vatvā imā gāthā abhāsi –
dhpak1.15:16.1: 19. “ Bahumpi ce saṃhita bhāsamāno, Na takkaro hoti naro pamatto;
dhpak1.15:16.2: Gopova gāvo gaṇayaṃ paresaṃ, Na bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
dhpak1.15:17.1: 19. “ Bahumpi ce saṃhita bhāsamāno, Na takkaro hoti naro pamatto;
dhpak1.15:17.2: Gopova gāvo gaṇayaṃ paresaṃ, Na bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
dhpak1.15:18.1: 20. “ Appampi ce saṃhita bhāsamāno, Dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī; Rāgañca dosañca pahāya mohaṃ,
dhpak1.15:18.2: Sammappajāno suvimuttacitto. “ Anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, Sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hotī ” ti.
dhpak1.15:19.1: 20. “ Appampi ce saṃhita bhāsamāno, Dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī; Rāgañca dosañca pahāya mohaṃ,
dhpak1.15:19.2: Sammappajāno suvimuttacitto. “ Anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, Sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hotī ” ti.
dhpak1.15:20.1: Gāthāpariyosāne bahū sotāpannādayo ahesuṃ. Desanā mahājanassa sātthikā jātāti.
